Mini Muffin-Tin Pizza Bites

Golden little pizza cups with melty mozzarella and pepperoni. This quick, higher-protein interpretation is inspired by the Reel’s muffin-tin method; the post caption doesn’t give a full ingredient list or quantities.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
7

Ingredients

  • 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese
  • 1 cup self-rising flour, plus a little for dusting
  • ⅓ cup pizza sauce
  • ¾ cup part-skim mozzarella, shredded
  • 2 oz turkey pepperoni, approximate amount
  • ½ tsp Italian seasoning
  • Cooking spray

Amounts are scaled from 4 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Heat oven to 400°F. Coat a 12-cup muffin pan with cooking spray.
  2. Blend cottage cheese until smooth. Mix with flour until a shaggy dough forms. If sticky, dust in a little extra flour.
  3. Divide dough into 12 pieces. Press each into a muffin cup, covering the bottom and sides to make a little shell.
  4. Spoon about 1 tsp sauce into each. Add mozzarella, turkey pepperoni and a pinch of Italian seasoning.
  5. Bake 14–17 minutes, until the edges are golden and centers are hot. Rest 3 minutes, loosen with a small spatula and serve warm.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
